causes: The repository-wide Prometheus control recognized only a local time/sleep implementation and rejected delegation to the canonical observer.
The Foundation smoke regression patched smoke.time even though the clock moved to observability.time.
The pre-final publication harness detached HEAD before the final checkpoint tag existed; the validator correctly required that tag.
The harness decoded child UTF-8 but re-emitted Angular's U+276F through cp1252 and raised UnicodeEncodeError.

notes: The harness failed while gate:webTests was emitting output. No stage or isolated rerun supersedes this red attempt; a new full invocation is allowed only after correcting all three causes.
